title: Executor report
description: The fixed report an executor ends with (design part 5.6), as parseReport returns it. Not a data file: the report is text, and this is its parsed form.

commit.description: The branch's final commit; null when the executor made none (blocked before any).

evidence.description: Commands and their results, one per entry.

runs.description: Benchmark run IDs with what each shows; empty for `runs: none`.

deviations.description: Departures from the plan or `touches`; empty for `none`.

questions.description: Anything for the orchestrator or a decider; empty for `none`.
